topics.definition: Artificial-intelligence regulation, datacenter infrastructure, technology investment, digital risks, education uses, privacy, and governance of digital systems.

topics.topic_name: 基础设施、公共土地与联邦投资
topics.english_name: Infrastructure, Public Lands, and Federal Investment
topics.definition: Construction and public infrastructure, public lands and conservation, federal or local grants, employment, and government investment decisions.

topics.topic_name: 贸易、公共卫生与法律权利
topics.english_name: Trade, Public Health, and Legal Rights
topics.definition: A broad policy cluster covering tariffs and international trade, vaccines and public-health administration, courts and legislation, abortion or civil rights, sanctions, and rights-related regulation.
topics.special_instruction: Always identify the specific subissue and evaluation target. Do not merge opposing evaluations of trade, public health, and legal rights into one direction without explaining the dominant target.

topics.topic_name: 伊朗战争、石油与能源安全
topics.english_name: Iran War, Oil, and Energy Security
topics.definition: Military escalation involving Iran, diplomacy and conflict around the Strait of Hormuz, oil flows and prices, and risks to energy supply and security.
topics.special_instruction: Separate war conditions, oil prices, and energy supply. A price increase is not automatically negative unless the text evaluates its consequences for a stated target.

topics.topic_name: 移民、公共资金与家庭经济
topics.english_name: Immigration, Public Funding, and Household Economy
topics.definition: Immigration enforcement and immigrant impacts, public grants and funding, business investment, inflation, affordability, and economic pressures on households and children.
topics.special_instruction: Always identify the specific subissue and evaluation target. Do not collapse immigration enforcement, public spending, and household living costs into one direction without explaining the dominant target.
